conflicts.permit: This permission allows APPSTARSTUDIOS to view app data (image, text, audio etc..) stored on their SD card.
conflicts.prohibit: We won’t access other file on SD card.
conflicts.situation: The app reads image, text, or audio files stored on the user's SD card other than the shared introduction picture.
conflicts.reason: One statement says the app views data stored on the SD card. The other says it accesses no SD card file other than the introduction picture. No scope or exception reconciles them.

conflicts.permit: We may collect your information when you communicate with us or you give us.
conflicts.situation: A user emails DVloper with a question, giving DVloper the user's email address and name.
conflicts.reason: The policy defines email addresses as Personal Information and says none is collected, yet says it collects information users give when communicating. No exception for correspondence is stated.

conflicts.permit: the Application may collect certain information automatically, including, but not limited to, the type of mobile device you use, your mobile devices unique device ID, the IP address of your mobile device
conflicts.situation: The game automatically collects the device's unique device ID and IP address during play.
conflicts.reason: Personal Information is defined to include information stored within the device, and the device ID is such information. The policy does not say device identifiers are excluded from that definition.

conflicts.permit: We may collect personal information about you when you use and access our website.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not collect any information about our users.
conflicts.situation: A user visits the GameDivision website, and pages visited, visit times, and IP address are recorded.
conflicts.reason: The policy states without qualification that it collects no information about users, and elsewhere that it collects personal information from website visitors. No scope or precedence separates them.

conflicts.permit: We may collect this information when you:
conflicts.prohibit: GameDivision (LabException) does not collect any user information.
conflicts.situation: A user registers in a GameDivision app or emails the company with a question.
conflicts.reason: The opening statement denies any collection of user information, while the general policy lists registration and email correspondence as occasions of collection. Neither statement limits the other.

conflicts.permit: We may share your username, email address, MAC address and Device ID (collectively, "Specific Shared Data") with certain of our Third Party Publishers and other business partners ("Preferred Partners")
conflicts.prohibit: Unless you specifically opt in to share your Personal Information, the information that we share with these third parties will only be used in the form of Non-Identifying Information to support user trend analyses and demographic profiling.
conflicts.situation: Without opt-in, Lilith shares a user's email address and Device ID with a Third Party Publisher or advertising business partner.
conflicts.reason: One section limits sharing with Third Party Publishers and advertisers to Non-Identifying Information absent opt-in. Another shares identifiers with Third Party Publishers and business partners by default. The policy does not say which governs.

conflicts.permit: We store this information for the sole purposes of measuring the effectiveness of our referral program and sending the email you initiated
conflicts.prohibit: Lilith hashes these email addresses after using them for the sole purpose of sending this one-time email.
conflicts.situation: After sending a referral invitation, Lilith keeps the friend's name and email address to measure the referral program.
conflicts.reason: One statement limits use of friend email addresses to sending the invitation, then hashing. The other stores the name and email to measure referral effectiveness. The policy does not reconcile the two purposes.

conflicts.permit: In connection with registration of Lilith Users on our Services, we collect Personal Information which may include your email address, as well as information on mobile device type, mobile carrier, unique mobile device identifier ("Device ID"), Internet Protocol ("IP") address and geo location, as applicable.
conflicts.prohibit: Unless you explicitly opt-in to permit the use and sharing of your Personal Information regarding your geographic location, your location data will only be collected and used anonymously in a form that does not personally identify you.
conflicts.situation: A user registers without opting in to location sharing, and Lilith records geo location with the registration email.
conflicts.reason: Registration collects geo location as Personal Information alongside email, while location data is said to be collected only anonymously without opt-in. The policy does not say whether the anonymity rule covers registration.

conflicts.permit: Location information provided via the Global Positioning System (GPS) functionality of your device or from your cellular service provider with your opt-in consent.
conflicts.prohibit: After your roadside assistance service request has been closed, your current location will no longer be shared with or visible to the roadside assistance provider or us.
conflicts.situation: A user who opted in to location keeps using the app after the roadside request is closed.
conflicts.reason: AAA collects GPS location whenever the app is used with consent and requires background location, yet says current location is no longer visible to AAA after a request closes. No scope reconciles them.

conflicts.permit: Personal information collected by Ashes2 Studio is information voluntarily provided to us by you when you create your account or change your account information.
conflicts.prohibit: We collect no personal information about you or your children through our apps.
conflicts.situation: A user creates an account in an Ashes2 Studio app, providing Facebook ID, name, gender, and location.
conflicts.reason: The policy states it collects no personal information through its apps, then lists personal information collected at account creation. No scope, product, or precedence separates the statements.

conflicts.permit: In such cases, Ashes2 Studio may be able to collect certain information from your social networking profile when your social networking site permits it, and when you consent to allow your social networking site to make that information available to Ashes2 Studio.
conflicts.prohibit: We collect no personal information about you or your children through our apps.
conflicts.situation: A user connects an Ashes2 Studio app to a social networking site, and the studio obtains name, email, and friend list.
conflicts.reason: The no-collection statement has no exception for social network connections, while another section collects profile information from social networking sites. The policy does not say which governs.

conflicts.permit: We may share information with our business partners.
conflicts.prohibit: we will not provide additional information to such third parties that enables such third parties to identify you
conflicts.situation: Wincrest shares a user's device ID or contact information with a business partner that also receives the app's anonymous location data.
conflicts.reason: Sharing with business partners is unrestricted in kind, while third parties receiving anonymous data must not receive identifying information. The policy does not say whether those recipients overlap or which statement governs.

conflicts.permit: Google may use the collected data to contextualize and personalize the ads of its own advertising network.
conflicts.prohibit: These third parties have access to your Personal Data only to perform these tasks on our behalf and are obligated not to disclose or use it for any other purpose.
conflicts.situation: Google Analytics, engaged as a service provider, uses data collected from Blogaway users to personalize ads on its own network.
conflicts.reason: Google Analytics is listed as a service provider, and service providers may not use data for other purposes. Yet Google may use the data for its own advertising. No exception is stated.

conflicts.permit: Third-parties that interact with us in connection with the services we provide.
conflicts.prohibit: We only obtain Personal Information that you provide to us, such as when you request information from DrFirst.
conflicts.situation: DrFirst receives a user's identity or contact information from a third party that interacts with it in providing services.
conflicts.reason: One statement limits Personal Information to what the user provides, while the CCPA section lists third parties as a source of Personal Information. The policy does not say which governs.

conflicts.permit: We may also share anonymized data, such as statistical or demographic information in aggregate form, with third parties for research or marketing purposes.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not sell or disclose deidentified Personal Information to third parties.
conflicts.situation: DrFirst shares aggregated demographic statistics derived from user information with a marketing firm.
conflicts.reason: Anonymized aggregate data derived from user information is deidentified Personal Information, yet one statement allows sharing it with third parties and the other forbids disclosure. No exception distinguishes them.
